Forecast — Royal Birkdale

Conditions Risk: Irish Sea W/NW winds create sustained 10–25mph conditions across all four rounds. Birkdale's exposed corridors on holes 4, 6, 12, 13, 15, and 18 amplify wind penalty. Approach precision from 150–200yds and links ARG skill are the primary separators. Trajectory control and wind management represent the decisive edges for championship contention.
